changelog: Big Battery Win: The live wallpaper is now static and redraws only once a minute instead of 30 times a second — far less drain, same look
Wallpaper Master Switch: Turn the whole wallpaper system on or off from Profile. It now ships OFF by default, so Odyssey never draws in the background unless you choose to
Your Own Wallpaper Stays Still: Once you pick a custom Lock or Home wallpaper, Odyssey stops refreshing altogether — no background work at all
Clock Never Lags: The wallpaper re-syncs on the exact minute boundary, so the time it shows is always right
Fixes: Lock and Home wallpapers are now restored separately when you switch the schedule wallpaper off, and an unused permission has been removed
